    Semantics Delivery Network: Rethinking Web Retrieval Infrastructure for LLM Agents

    语义交付网络：重新思考面向 LLM 智能体的 Web 检索基础设施

    Peichun Hua and Yunming Xiao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes chunk-level indexing, retrieval, and caching as a delivery substrate for LLM agents, supported by preliminary measurements and a research agenda. Reasoning and chunk composition are context for the design, while the central contribution is a transferable systems architecture for retrieval state and delivery.

    本文提出一种面向 LLM 智能体的交付底层架构，以块为粒度进行索引、检索和缓存，并提供了初步测量结果和研究议程。推理和块组合是该设计的背景；其核心贡献是可迁移的检索状态与交付系统架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) increasingly ground their answers in proprietary data and live web content through both single-shot retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and multi-turn agentic search. Yet the web path they use was built for human readers: search services return URLs and snippets ranked by generic relevance, and content delivery networks (CDNs) cache URL-addressed objects without knowing which passage an agent needs. LLMs instead consume short, semantically coherent passages - hereafter, chunks - selected for downstream utility rather than similarity alone, retrieve statefully across reasoning turns, and, as uncoordinated streams, repeatedly fetch, clean, chunk, and embed the same content. We argue that semantic chunk retrieval should become a first-class network-delivery abstraction, and propose the Semantics Delivery Network (SemDN): an origin-authorized, hierarchical substrate that indexes, searches, and caches web content at chunk granularity, serving clients and origins alike. SemDN is more than finer-grained caching: it must estimate missing or stale evidence without an explicit miss signal, let clients choose retrieval representations that origins need not see, and share state among clients with the same representation. Preliminary results show that page-first retrieval processes two to three orders of magnitude more content than agents consume, that agentic queries exhibit task-local chunk reuse invisible to URL caches, and that chunk delivery improves answer quality per context token. We organize an open research agenda around shareable retrieval state, hierarchical caching and refresh under coverage risk, and deployability, including incentives, privacy, and verifiability. Our code is available at: https://github.com/sarendis56/SemDN_HotNets26

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过单轮检索增强生成（RAG）和多轮智能体搜索，基于专有数据和实时 Web 内容生成回答。然而，它们使用的 Web 访问路径原本是为人类读者构建的：搜索服务返回按通用相关性排序的 URL 和摘要，内容分发网络（CDN）缓存以 URL 寻址的对象，却不知道智能体需要其中哪个段落。相比之下，LLM 消费的是简短且语义连贯的文本段落（下文称为块），这些块根据下游效用而非单纯相似度进行选择；它们会跨推理轮次进行有状态检索，而且由于彼此互不协调，会反复获取、清理、切分并嵌入相同内容。我们主张，语义块检索应成为一等网络交付抽象，并提出语义交付网络（SemDN）：一种经内容源授权的分层底层架构，以块为粒度索引、搜索和缓存 Web 内容，同时服务客户端和内容源。SemDN 不只是更细粒度的缓存：它必须在没有明确未命中信号的情况下估计证据是否缺失或过时，允许客户端选择内容源无需知晓的检索表征，并在采用相同表征的客户端之间共享状态。初步结果表明，先检索页面的方式处理的内容量比智能体实际消费的内容多出两个到三个数量级；智能体式查询存在任务局部的块复用，而 URL 缓存无法发现这种复用；按块交付能提高每个上下文 token 所对应的回答质量。我们围绕可共享的检索状态、覆盖风险下的分层缓存与刷新，以及可部署性（包括激励、隐私和可验证性）梳理了一份开放研究议程。我们的代码见：https://github.com/sarendis56/SemDN_HotNets26

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    本文测量了 LLM 智能体记忆投毒防御在良性场景下对准确率和 token 成本的影响，发现重排序器可能扣留有用记忆。这是对智能体记忆系统评估的一项实质性经验贡献；推理只是评估背景，并未直接推动推理方法的发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory-poisoning defenses for LLM agents are typically evaluated by how well they stop attacks, even though almost all traffic they encounter is benign. We measure their cost when no attack is present. Our harness holds the memory backend, retrieval, answer prompt, and judge constant, changing only the defense. We test four defenses on half of LoCoMo: five long conversations with 750 turns and 255 questions per run, repeated three times each. Replication proved necessary: one run showed a reranker cost on adversarial questions that the other two did not. The three write-time defenses (sanitization, provenance checking, and LLM-based anomaly detection) never fired on benign traffic. We detect no accuracy cost from them at a resolution of about $\pm$4 points; anomaly detection adds 1.2% token overhead. The read-time reranker, with 2.7% token overhead, fired on 9.9% of its memory decisions and withheld memory from 45% of questions. It lowered core accuracy by 4.4 points (95% CI [-9.0, -0.05]; McNemar p = 0.064). The effect is borderline in magnitude, but its direction held across all six runs that used the reranker. A blind audit found content-based justification for only 2 of 50 sampled drops. Stacking all four defenses raised token overhead to 4.1% but did not compound the accuracy cost. In our runs, cost tracked what each defense judged and how much context it used, rather than whether it used an LLM. Attack success rate reveals none of this, so benign cost should be reported alongside it. We release the harness, labels, and per-run outputs.

    中文

    LLM 智能体的记忆投毒防御通常按阻止攻击的效果进行评估，尽管它们遇到的流量几乎全是良性的。我们测量无攻击时这些防御的代价。我们的测试框架固定记忆后端、检索方式、回答提示和评判器，只改变防御措施。我们在 LoCoMo 一半的数据上测试了四种防御：五段长对话，每次运行包含 750 轮和 255 个问题，每种设置重复三次。重复实验证明是必要的：一次运行显示重排序器在对抗性问题上造成了代价，而另外两次没有。三种写入时防御（净化、来源核验和基于 LLM 的异常检测）在良性流量上从未触发。在约 $\pm$4 分的分辨率下，我们未检测到它们造成的准确率损失；异常检测会增加 1.2% 的 token 开销。读取时重排序器的 token 开销为 2.7%，它在 9.9% 的记忆决策中触发，并对 45% 的问题扣留了记忆。它使核心准确率降低了 4.4 分（95% CI [-9.0, -0.05]；McNemar p = 0.064）。影响幅度处于临界范围，但在使用重排序器的全部六次运行中，影响方向一致。盲审发现，抽样的 50 次扣留中只有 2 次有基于内容的理由。叠加全部四种防御后，token 开销升至 4.1%，但准确率损失没有叠加。在我们的运行中，成本取决于各项防御评判的内容以及使用了多少上下文，而非是否使用 LLM。攻击成功率无法揭示这些情况，因此应同时报告良性场景下的成本。我们公开发布测试框架、标签和逐次运行的输出。

    FlashBoB: I/O-Efficient Exact Backward-over-Backward for Softmax Attention

    FlashBoB：面向 Softmax 注意力的 I/O 高效精确反向的反向算法

    Anthony Givans, Michael Crawshaw, Mingrui Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FlashBoB contributes an exact, memory-efficient algorithm for second-order differentiation through attention, using a hierarchical affine structure to reduce memory traffic and scale to long contexts. Its connection to reasoning is through applications such as test-time training and meta-learning, while the main contribution is computational systems design rather than reasoning or interpretability.

    FlashBoB 提出一种精确且内存高效的算法，用于对注意力进行二阶求导；该算法利用分层仿射结构减少内存流量，并扩展到长上下文。它与推理的联系体现在测试时训练和元学习等应用上，而其主要贡献是计算系统设计，并非推理或可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Transformer models built on the attention mechanism have become a central building block in modern deep learning, yet softmax attention remains a major bottleneck for long-context workloads. While FlashAttention makes the forward and first backward passes I/O-efficient, it does not support backward-over-backward (BoB), which enables exact differentiation through the backward pass for applications such as second-order optimization, test-time training, gradient-based memory, and meta-learning. Existing BoB implementations either materialize large intermediate tensors or exhaust GPU memory at long sequence lengths. We present FlashBoB, an exact, I/O-efficient algorithm for BoB in softmax attention that keeps computation within on-chip tiles and avoids all $N \times N$ intermediate tensors, where $N$ is the sequence length. The key insight is a hierarchical affine structure in the softmax double backward: two row-wise scalars determine all outputs through affine transformations. This yields a two-pass schedule with bounded on-chip static random-access memory (SRAM) usage and minimal off-chip high-bandwidth memory (HBM) traffic. FlashBoB achieves $\Theta(N^2 d^2/M)$ HBM traffic ($d$ is the head dimension and $M$ is the memory size) and, within the standard FlashAttention-style score-recomputation model, matches the inherited large-cache lower bound for exact forward attention. Empirically, it scales exact attention BoB to $N=262\text{K}$ on a single A100 80GB GPU, where prior PyTorch exact baselines fail by $N=16\text{K}$, and is up to $6.3\times$ faster than FlashBack. These results make exact second-order attention practical at long-context sequence lengths where prior implementations cannot run efficiently.

    中文

    基于注意力机制构建的 Transformer 模型已成为现代深度学习的核心构件，但 softmax 注意力仍是长上下文工作负载的主要瓶颈。FlashAttention 使前向传播和第一次反向传播具备 I/O 效率，但不支持反向的反向（BoB）；BoB 可实现对反向传播过程的精确求导，适用于二阶优化、测试时训练、基于梯度的记忆和元学习等应用。现有 BoB 实现要么显式构造大型中间张量，要么在长序列长度下耗尽 GPU 内存。我们提出 FlashBoB，这是一种针对 softmax 注意力的精确且具备 I/O 效率的 BoB 算法，它将计算限制在片上分块内，并避免所有$N \times N$中间张量，其中$N$表示序列长度。其关键洞见是，softmax 二阶反向传播具有分层仿射结构：两个逐行标量通过仿射变换即可确定所有输出。这形成了一个两遍调度方案，其片上静态随机存取存储器（SRAM）用量有界，片外高带宽内存（HBM）流量极低。FlashBoB 实现了$\Theta(N^2 d^2/M)$的 HBM 流量（$d$表示头维度，$M$表示内存大小）；在标准的 FlashAttention 风格分数重计算模型下，它达到了精确前向注意力继承自大缓存模型的下界。在实证评估中，它能在单张 A100 80GB GPU 上将精确注意力 BoB 扩展到$N=262\text{K}$，而先前的 PyTorch 精确基线会因$N=16\text{K}$而失败；其速度最高可达 FlashBack 的$6.3\times$倍。这些结果使得在长上下文序列长度下进行精确二阶注意力计算成为现实，而先前的实现无法高效运行。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Verified search, in which a language model proposes programs, a hard evaluator scores them, and selection keeps the best, has recently moved mathematical records; controlled ablations of the proposer-side components remain rare. We instrument a minimal FunSearch-style loop at office scale (a 30B local model on a laptop, 120-600 verified samples per run) with three operator packages: a schematic notebook the model writes and carries instead of verbatim elites, a named obstacle, and behavioural repulsion from constructions already found. On nine construction problems from a public repository, the complete 2^3 factorial with two replicates favours the primary contrast in a nominal two-stage analysis: the composition closes more of the seed-to-record gap (+0.196; nominal pooled p=0.023, stage-combination p~0.08; median per-problem effect +0.045). Repulsion raises construction-hash diversity in eight of nine problems (one-sided p=0.0039; partly a manipulation check). The factorial finds no positive memory-by-repulsion interaction (bounded to about +/-0.04); the gain decomposes additively, and memory+repulsion is the only arm that never collapses (0 of 18 runs), within 0.025 of the full composition. A frontier proposer under the identical loop reaches in tens of samples what the local model does not in hundreds; in single scoping runs its gains arrive without the operators. The searches stall after closing 85-92% of the gap on the flagship problem, and a later analysis reads that plateau as a resolution limit: the reference value is a continuum limit and the unaided long-run finals already carry its family's structure. In the registered family-hint test the family named in words is adopted and loses; handed as code, it is optimized, but our best finite-grid encoding stays below the plateau reached unaided. We release the harness, every candidate, and the dated pre-registrations.

    中文

    验证搜索通过语言模型提出程序、硬评估器对程序评分、再由选择机制保留最优方案，近期已推动数学纪录进步；然而，对提议者端组件进行受控消融的研究仍然少见。我们在办公规模下构建了一个最简 FunSearch 风格循环（笔记本电脑上的 30B 本地模型，每次运行验证 120–600 个样本），并配备三种算子包：模型编写并持续携带的示意性笔记本（取代逐字保留精英样本）、一个明确命名的障碍，以及对已发现构造的行为排斥。在一个公开仓库中的九个构造问题上，带两次重复的完整 2^3 因子实验在名义上的两阶段分析中支持主要对比：组合方案弥合了更多从种子到纪录的差距（+0.196；名义合并 p=0.023，阶段合并 p~0.08；逐问题效应中位数 +0.045）。在九个问题中的八个问题上，排斥机制提高了构造哈希多样性（单侧 p=0.0039；这部分也是操纵检验）。因子实验未发现正向的记忆与排斥交互作用（范围约为 +/-0.04）；增益可分解为相加效应，而“记忆+排斥”是唯一从未崩溃的实验组（18 次运行中 0 次），且与完整组合方案相差不超过 0.025。使用相同循环的前沿提议者只需数十个样本就能达到本地模型数百个样本仍未达到的结果；在单次探索性运行中，它的增益无需这些算子即可实现。在标志性问题上，搜索弥合了 85–92% 的差距后便停滞；后续分析将这一平台期解释为分辨率限制：参考值是一个连续极限，而未经辅助的长程最终结果已经具备其构造族的结构。在预注册的构造族提示测试中，用文字命名的构造族被采用后导致性能下降；以代码形式提供时，该构造族会得到优化，但我们最好的有限网格编码仍低于未经辅助搜索所达到的平台期。我们公开发布测试框架、每个候选方案和带日期的预注册文件。

    Compositional Safety Failures in Harness Evolution: Identification and Runtime Monitoring

    Harness 演化中的组合安全失效：识别与运行时监控

    Zhixiang Zhang, Zesen Liu, Wai Ip Lai, Hongxu chen, Dongdong She

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies safety failures that emerge from interactions among individually safe harness updates and proposes typed hypergraph monitoring to track those interactions efficiently. This directly advances composition in evolving agent systems; its safety focus offers only a limited connection to reasoning, and it does not study internal model mechanisms.

    本文识别出由各自安全的 harness 更新相互作用而产生的安全失效，并提出类型化超图监控机制，以高效追踪这些交互。这直接推动了演化型智能体系统中的组合研究；其安全重点与推理只有有限关联，也未研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-evolving agent harnesses continually update persistent components such as memory, prompts, skills, and tools. We call this process harness evolution. However, such evolution could introduce unexpected safety risks. Existing work studies harness misevolution and validates candidate harnesses or attributed individual component updates, leaving safety analysis of cross-component update interactions largely unexamined. To address this gap, we study compositional safety failures in harness evolution, where interactions among individually safe and utility-preserving component updates can produce undesirable or unsafe agent behavior, revealing a safety risk intrinsic to harness evolution. Across three safety-related benchmarks, we identify 43 pairwise and 18 irreducible 3-way compositional safety failures. Conventional solution incurs combinatorial complexity in validating cross-component interactions, leaving the safety checking impractical as the harness evolves. To solve this, we introduced a typed hypergraph that represents component states as nodes and safety-relevant higher-order interactions as hyperedges. When the harness changes, the hypergraph updates only the interaction neighborhood of the changed states rather than reconstructing the global composition space. Building on that, we develop a hypergraph-guided runtime monitoring mechanism. Experiments show that our method effectively mitigates compositional safety risks while preserving task utility and reducing interaction-checking costs, and further reveal an empirical safety-utility-cost trade-off across different safety mechanisms.

    中文

    自我演化的智能体 harness 会持续更新记忆、提示、技能和工具等持久化组件。我们将这一过程称为 harness 演化。然而，这种演化可能引入意料之外的安全风险。现有工作研究 harness 演化失常，并验证候选 harness 或归因到单个组件的更新，却很少分析跨组件更新交互的安全性。为弥补这一空白，我们研究 harness 演化中的组合安全失效：各自安全且能保持效用的组件更新相互作用后，可能导致不良或不安全的智能体行为，从而揭示 harness 演化固有的安全风险。在三个安全相关基准上，我们识别出 43 个两两组合安全失效和 18 个不可约的三方组合安全失效。采用常规方案验证跨组件交互会带来组合复杂度，使得 harness 演化过程中的安全检查难以实际执行。为解决这一问题，我们引入一种类型化超图，将组件状态表示为节点，将与安全相关的高阶交互表示为超边。harness 发生变化时，超图只更新变化状态的交互邻域，而不必重建整个组合空间。在此基础上，我们开发了一种由超图引导的运行时监控机制。实验表明，该方法能有效缓解组合安全风险，同时保持任务效用并降低交互检查成本；实验还揭示了不同安全机制之间经验上的安全性、效用与成本权衡。

    R$^2$ Flow：通过递归技能演化实现递归自我改进

    Mingda Zhang, Qiang Huang, Yanjin Li, Zijia Wang, Qika Lin, Xiaoying Tang, Tiesunlong Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    R² Flow develops a verified, recursive skill-evolution method for LLM agents, using shared-state graphs, flow-based credit, and utility-ranked library updates. It substantially advances agent systems and reasoning improvement; reusable skill composition is relevant but secondary, and it does not study internal model mechanisms.

    R² Flow 为 LLM 智能体开发了一种经过验证的递归技能演化方法，采用共享状态图、基于流的贡献归因，以及按效用排序的技能库更新。它显著推动了智能体系统和推理能力改进；可复用的技能组合与之相关，但属于次要内容；该研究并未考察模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-based agents can improve themselves across tasks by reusing and revising the skills they orchestrate into executable procedures. Flow-based training fits this loop: it samples procedures in proportion to reward, and the flow through each skill credits it for the next library revision. Three obstacles stand in the way of making this self-improvement reliable: flow training suffers strategy collapse over tree-structured histories; nonnegative flow-based credit rewards frequent use as if it were benefit; and library edits rest on the task reward the policy optimizes. We introduce R$^2$ Flow, a recursive self-improvement framework that alternates policy learning, independent verification, and versioned skill-library updates on a shared-state orchestration graph. The graph merges histories that differ only in the order of independent steps, allowing flow training to pool evidence across equivalent executions. A flow-share readout of the trained flow, invariant to the backward policy, and a separate signed utility rank which skills to change, verifier evidence decides whether an edit is warranted, and a residual-variance plateau sets when to update. Committed edits reshape the graph the next policy learns on, realizing recursive skill evolution. Across question answering, mathematical reasoning, interactive decision making, and code generation, R$^2$ Flow improves task accuracy and library-edit precision over heuristic orchestration, reinforcement learning, and skill-evolution baselines, and transfers across executors. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow.

    中文

    基于 LLM 的智能体可以通过重用和修订其编排成可执行流程的技能，在不同任务中自我改进。基于流的训练适合这一循环：它按奖励成比例地采样流程，并通过每项技能中的流量，为其在下一次库修订中提供贡献归因。要使这种自我改进可靠，存在三项障碍：基于流的训练在树状历史中会出现策略崩溃；非负的基于流的贡献归因会把频繁使用当作收益来奖励；而技能库编辑依赖于策略所优化的任务奖励。我们提出 R$^2$ Flow，这是一种递归自我改进框架，在共享状态编排图上交替进行策略学习、独立验证和带版本管理的技能库更新。该图会合并仅在独立步骤顺序上有所不同的历史，使基于流的训练能够汇集等价执行的证据。训练所得流量的流量份额读出不受反向策略影响；另行计算的有符号效用对技能进行排序，以决定要修改哪些技能；验证器证据决定编辑是否有充分依据，而残差方差平台期则确定何时更新。已提交的编辑会重塑下一策略所学习的图，从而实现递归技能演化。在问答、数学推理、交互式决策和代码生成任务中，R$^2$ Flow 相较于启发式编排、强化学习和技能演化基线，提升了任务准确率和技能库编辑精度，并且能够迁移到不同执行器。代码见 https://github.com/beita6969/r2flow.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The transition from Large Language Models (LLMs) to agents shifts safety stakes from toxic text to irreversible environmental harm. While current defenses remain largely retrospective, proactive runtime intervention is bottlenecked by the lack of large-scale, causally-consistent data. We propose PROACT-Agent, a framework for synthesizing high-fidelity trajectories to enable real-time guardrails. We identify a critical "safety drift" in prior benchmarks, where lenient annotation paradigms fail to enforce temporal consistency. PROACT-Agent addresses this through: (1) Progressive Trajectory Unrolling to reveal risks hidden in long-context interactions; (2) Reasoning-Augmented Causal Rectification to enforce monotonic causal consistency; and (3) Culturally-Aware Data Localization for cross-border robustness. We introduce PROACT-Bench, a bilingual safety benchmark with 155,780 states labeled through multi-model adjudication. Evaluating updated context before the next LLM inference, the trained guard achieves 91.46% unsafe-class F1 and 90.63% exact-boundary detection under complete source holdout. In AgentDojo, it reduces non-DoS targeted attack success from 20.82% to 0.40%.

    CollabFlow: Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Collaboration

    CollabFlow：智能体协作的递归自我改进

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CollabFlow learns how agents form teams and exchange evidence, with a flow-based objective that maintains multiple high-reward teams across rounds. This substantially advances multi-agent organization, with partial contributions to reusable team composition and outcome-based improvement; it does not investigate internal model mechanisms.

    CollabFlow 学习如何组建智能体团队并交换证据，并通过基于流的目标函数，使多个高奖励团队在不同轮次中保持活跃。这显著推动了多智能体组织的发展，也对可复用的团队组合和基于结果的改进作出了部分贡献；但它没有研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets a system improve from its own outcomes; in LLM-based multi-agent systems, Agents refine one another within a task, and outcomes improve how they collaborate across tasks. However, existing multi-agent collaboration leaves this loop open: collaboration is pre-defined at the operator level, topology-only learning keeps verbatim exchange that propagates errors, and reward maximization on a system's own outcomes concentrates on a few teams. To address these challenges, we propose CollabFlow, an RSI system of Learned Agent Collaboration: a trainable Collab-Director constructs teams of complete Agents, a frozen executor runs them, and each round's outcomes retrain the director. Within each round, the edges of a collaboration graph carry protocols of Evidence-Conditioned Communication: a receiver adopts a differing answer only when the sender's evidence is stronger by a margin, so the director learns who communicates and how. Across rounds, we further propose Collaborative Trajectory Balance (CTB), a flow-based objective that credits each team once across its construction orders and targets a reward-proportional distribution over teams, so several good teams stay in play. We also bound how far this self-generated target moves between rounds, which shrinks as records accumulate. On twelve datasets, CollabFlow outperforms all baselines and keeps improving across rounds. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CollabFlow-631E.

    中文

    递归自我改进（RSI）使系统能够根据自身结果加以改进；在基于 LLM 的多智能体系统中，智能体在任务内相互改进，而任务结果则推动它们在不同任务之间改进协作方式。然而，现有多智能体协作并未形成完整的这一循环：协作在算子层面是预先定义的，仅学习拓扑结构的方法会保留逐字交流，从而传播错误，而基于系统自身结果进行奖励最大化又会使少数团队占据主导。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 CollabFlow，一种学习智能体协作（Learned Agent Collaboration）的 RSI 系统：可训练的 Collab-Director 构建由完整智能体组成的团队，冻结的执行器运行这些团队，并在每一轮结束后利用结果重新训练指挥器。在每一轮中，协作图的边承载证据条件通信（Evidence-Conditioned Communication）协议：只有当发送方的证据以一定幅度强于接收方时，接收方才会采纳不同的答案，因此指挥器能够学习谁与谁通信以及如何通信。在不同轮次之间，我们进一步提出协作轨迹平衡（Collaborative Trajectory Balance，CTB），这是一种基于流的目标函数：它会对每个团队的各种构建顺序统一计分一次，并以按奖励成比例的团队分布为目标，从而让多个优秀团队持续参与。我们还对这一自行生成的目标在不同轮次间的变化幅度给出上界；随着记录累积，该上界会收窄。在十二个数据集上，CollabFlow 优于所有基线，并且持续逐轮改进。代码见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CollabFlow-631E。

    When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness generalizes: with rounds fixed, held-out success rises as the training batch grows from 5 to 100 rollouts, while small batches overfit the training tasks. Second, the optimizer agent must not be given free rein. Accepting every revision it proposes degrades the harness within a few rounds; a simple Champion-Challenger rule that promotes a revision only if it beats the incumbent on the same fixed cases turns the same loop into one that raises held-out success on LIBERO tasks from 51% to 67% over 30 rounds. The evolved harness is also a natural place to attach a pretrained policy, through one tool that hands it control. Distilling the rollouts of that combination back into the policy with multi-teacher on-policy distillation yields a standalone policy at 62.2% on RoboCasa365 under the official protocol, 4.8 points above its starting point with no harness at inference; the evolved harness on top of the distilled policy reaches 71.2% on the RoboCasa365 leaderboard benchmark, 13.1 points above the best published entry, and the loop closes when harness evolution resumes on the stronger policy. Automatic harness evolution for visual-interface robot agents is thus feasible, but its gains hinge on the rollout scale behind each decision and on how the optimizer agent's revisions are selected.

    中文

    当直接将现成的编程智能体用作机器人策略时，智能体通过屏幕截图观察基于浏览器的 3D 界面，并通过少数几个工具移动虚拟目标夹爪；此时，智能体的 harness（包括提示、工具和控制规则）在很大程度上决定了任务成败，而此前这些内容一直由人工编写。我们表明，另一个编程智能体（优化器智能体）可以自动改进这个 harness，并报告两个有关其有效性的发现。第一，优化器智能体每轮看到的 rollout 数量决定了演化后的 harness 能否泛化：固定轮数时，随着训练批次从 5 个 rollout 增至 100 个，留出集成功率上升；较小批次则会对训练任务过拟合。第二，不能让优化器智能体不受约束地行动。若接受它提出的每项修改，harness 会在几轮内退化；一种简单的冠军—挑战者规则只有在修改版本于同一组固定用例上胜过现有版本时才予以晋升，这让同一循环在 30 轮内将 LIBERO 任务的留出集成功率从 51% 提升到 67%。演化后的 harness 也很适合作为预训练策略的连接点，只需通过一个工具将控制权交给该策略。使用多教师同策略蒸馏将二者组合产生的 rollout 蒸馏回策略后，在官方协议下，独立策略在 RoboCasa365 上达到 62.2%，比其起始水平高 4.8 个百分点，而且推理时无需 harness；在蒸馏后的策略上叠加演化后的 harness，则在 RoboCasa365 排行榜基准上达到 71.2%，比已发表的最佳结果高 13.1 个百分点；随后在更强的策略上恢复 harness 演化，形成闭环。因此，面向视觉界面机器人智能体的自动 harness 演化是可行的，但其增益取决于每次决策所依据的 rollout 规模，以及优化器智能体的修改如何经过筛选。

    Zheng Lin, Shaoke Fang, Yuxin Zhang, Jinfeng Xu, Zihan Fang, Zhe Chen, Wei Ni, Jun Luo, Symeon Chatzinotas

    DS-MoE selects expert subsets by modeling redundancy and synergy, then uses a majorization-minimization algorithm with provable guarantees; this offers a limited insight into relationships among learned representations.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-$k$ ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable guarantees to efficiently identify a high-quality expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.

    中文

    尽管混合专家（MoE）模型通过稀疏激活有效扩展了模型容量，但其部署往往受制于高昂的内存需求。提取紧凑的专家子集是一种很有前景的解决方案。然而，现有的专家选择启发式方法主要依赖 Top-$k$ 排名，这种方法孤立地评估单个专家，忽略了 MoE 门控网络引入的复杂专家间依赖关系。本文提出 DS-MoE，这是一种具有理论依据的框架，通过子模函数之差（DS）优化重新定义专家选择。通过分析损失退化的二阶泰勒展开，我们揭示了专家组合中的功能二元性：冗余（专家编码了重叠的表征）和协同（专家提供互补的误差抵消）。为处理这种二元性，我们通过将选择目标形式化为 DS 函数，在数学上将冗余削减与协同最大化解耦。此外，我们设计了一种专用的主化-最小化（MM）算法，并给出可证明的保证，以高效识别高质量的专家子集。大量实验表明，DS-MoE 能有效保留不可或缺的专家组合，性能优于最先进的基线方法。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemMux provides runtime verification and resource governance for parallel coding agents, with measurable attribution, reclamation, and admission under memory pressure. This substantially advances agent execution and resource management, but the abstract reports systems engineering rather than new reasoning, compositional, or model-mechanism insights.

    MemMux 为并行编码智能体提供运行时验证和资源治理，并能在内存压力下对资源归属、回收和接纳进行量化。这显著推进了智能体执行和资源管理，但摘要报告的是系统工程成果，而非新的推理、组合或模型机制见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Developers increasingly run a fleet of coding agents side by side on one workstation. Terminal multiplexers like tmux and a new generation of agent managers were built to arrange windows, not to govern memory. When ten agents each spawn language servers, test runners, and browsers, no standard tool can say how much memory belongs to which agent, confirm that a terminated agent's descendants are gone, notice a child that has escaped its agent, or keep the machine off the swap cliff when an out-of-memory (OOM) kill would silently discard uncommitted work. We treat these as runtime-verification problems: a hosting substrate should emit signals an operator can check while agents run. We present MemMux, an unprivileged local runtime (no kernel control groups) turning resource governance into checkable signals: per-agent attribution, complete reclamation, escaped-process visibility, bounded footprint under overcommit, and monitoring overhead. A claims-disciplined benchmark measures each against tmux and a raw-process baseline on identical workloads. Under a binding memory budget on a Linux host, MemMux holds the fleet under budget (7500 MiB) with zero swap by admitting a subset and reclaiming under pressure, while the ungoverned tools run every agent, pin the machine at its RAM ceiling (2x over budget), and spill about 2 GiB into swap. MemMux reclaims 100% of a terminated agent's process subtree where the raw baseline strands half of it (tmux matches us here; the raw baseline does not), and it is the only launcher we compare against that surfaces escaped children (10 of 10 detected). The cost: the always-on 1 Hz monitoring loop runs near 0.6% CPU at one agent but 2.7% at ten, above our 2% target. Running the harness on real Claude Code sessions shows 100% attribution and low overhead carry over to live agent trees. We release the engine, benchmark, and reproducer.

    Agent evolvers automate the design of the prompts, skills and workflows around language model agents, yet the optimization process they follow is still designed by hand: a fixed search loop decides how candidates are evaluated, which are kept and when the search stops. We propose FREEEVOLVE, which automates this process as well. An environment specifies the goal, target agent, evaluator, data and resource limits; within these limits, the evolver itself decides what to test, how much evidence to collect, which candidates to pursue and when to stop. These decisions follow an editable evolution skill, which we improve through meta-evolution by scoring each candidate skill on the fresh target agent it produces. The optimization process thus becomes a capability learned from experience rather than a loop engineered in advance. On tau3-bench, ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3 and Terminal-Bench 2.1, FREEEVOLVE controls the evolution campaign by itself, yet improves the primary held-out metric by 13.6 points on average and matches or exceeds hand-designed evolvers. The learned process keeps improving with experience: meta-evolved skills add 6.9 points over the seed skill on fresh target agents, demonstrating transferability across environments.

    ENGLISH

    Proactive agents can support group collaboration by surfacing useful information without waiting to be asked, but even relevant contributions can be disruptive if poorly timed. In this work, we isolate the timing question: given a fixed candidate contribution such as a clarification or relevant fact, when should an AI agent chime in? We introduce PITCH (Proactive Intervention Timing in CHat), to our knowledge the first benchmark with large-scale human judgments of proactive agent timing collected from participants in the same unscripted multi-party conversations they took part in. To collect high-quality judgments, we design a novel interface in which 2-4 people chat synchronously, author candidate AI contribution messages, place their own and others' contributions into the chat history, and then deliberate as a group about the best placement for each message. PITCH contains 384 candidate contributions and 1,091 judgments, each marking an ideal turn, an acceptable window, or that a contribution should not appear, from 89 participants engaged in 35 conversations. Evaluating 15 models across 28 configurations, we find that while models can place contributions well when given the entire conversation history, they systematically chime in too early when asked to decide live as the conversation unfolds: best-turn accuracy falls from 57.8% to 19.0%, with nearly half of placements occurring before every participant's acceptable window. In comparison, lay humans deciding live are more accurate (23.7% vs 19.0%), and fewer of their placements are premature (39.7% vs 46.4%). Model reasoning traces show that 93% of intervention justifications cite relevance, while almost none consider waiting. By providing a human-grounded benchmark, our work reveals gaps in agents' ability to integrate into group settings and points towards proactive agents that can reason explicitly about appropriate timing.

    Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) is primarily performed during post-training, while recent work has also begun incorporating safety data into pre-training. Yet safety can degrade when later training no longer includes safety data, and gains in safety often come at the cost of general capability. This tension suggests that safety and general reasoning should not be treated as separate training goals. We instead view safety as an LLM capability that can be learned through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. Both require the model to understand intent or task goals, apply relevant knowledge, and reason about potential consequences. We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning through this shared structure. Given safety and utility prompts, the base model generates structured documents and reasoning traces that are then used for mid-training. Safety mid-training reduces average attack success rate (ASR) by 72% to 81% relative to Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models, while also improving general capability. The benefits persist through subsequent post-training. After general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines without sacrificing general capability. They also retain safety under general-only GRPO without safety rewards, while subsequent RL reaches a better safety-utility frontier when initialized from the mid-trained models. Together, these results suggest that learning safety and general reasoning within a shared mid-training stage can reduce the safety-utility trade-off and make safety more robust to subsequent training.

    大型语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐主要在后训练阶段进行，同时近期研究也开始将安全数据纳入预训练。然而，如果后续训练不再包含安全数据，安全性可能会下降；而提升安全性往往要以一般能力为代价。这种张力表明，不应将安全和一般推理视为相互独立的训练目标。我们转而将安全视为一种 LLM 能力，它可以通过与一般任务共享的推理结构来学习。两者都要求模型理解意图或任务目标、运用相关知识，并推理潜在后果。我们提出安全中期训练，即位于预训练与后训练之间的一个阶段，通过这种共享结构共同发展安全能力和一般推理能力。给定安全和效用提示后，基础模型会生成结构化文档和推理轨迹，并将其用于中期训练。相较于 Qwen3-1.7B、4B 和 8B 基础模型，安全中期训练使平均攻击成功率（ASR）降低 72% 至 81%，同时提升一般能力。这些收益在后续后训练中仍能保持。经过仅针对一般能力的 SFT 后，中期训练模型大体保留了安全性，在不牺牲一般能力的情况下实现了低于基线的 ASR。在不使用安全奖励、仅针对一般能力的 GRPO 下，它们也能保留安全性；而后续 RL 若以中期训练模型为初始模型，则能达到更优的安全性与效用权衡前沿。总之，这些结果表明，在共享的中期训练阶段学习安全和一般推理，能够减少安全与效用之间的权衡，并增强安全性抵御后续训练的能力。

    RSI Control: Can AI Models Perform Covert Sabotage in the Self-Improvement Process?

    RSI Control：AI 模型能否在自我改进过程中实施隐蔽破坏？

    Kaiwen Zhou, Udari Madhushani Sehwag

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces and evaluates a testbed for covert sabotage by autonomous R&D agents during successor-model training, finding that attacks can evade transcript-based monitors and that reasoning access improves detection. Agent task execution and monitoring are a substantial systems contribution, while reasoning is studied as attack behavior; it does not explain internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文提出并评估了一个测试平台，用于研究自主研发智能体在训练后继模型期间实施隐蔽破坏的行为；研究发现，攻击可以躲过基于运行记录的监控，而访问推理过程能提升检测能力。智能体执行任务和监控构成了重要的系统贡献；推理在此作为攻击行为进行研究，但本文没有解释内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement, in which frontier AI models work on training the next generation, is quickly becoming a reality. However, the safety of this process has received far less attention than it should. A misaligned model training its successor can shape what that successor knows, how it behaves, and what it wants, and the harm carries forward into the next generation. We study this risk through the lens of AI control. We introduce RSI Control Arena, a testbed in which a frontier model, acting as an autonomous R\&D agent, is given a benign main task from a stage of a successor model's training pipeline together with a covert side task to install a misaligned property in the successor. The testbed contains 16 side tasks in three classes, forming 22 task pairs with main tasks that span the pipeline from data curation to reinforcement learning. We evaluate six frontier models as agents against LLM monitors that read the transcript of the run and the agent's reasoning. We observe that every model completes a substantial share of the side tasks without degrading the main-task performance, including side tasks that make the successor itself a better saboteur. Under minimal instructions to stay covert, models already produce successful attacks that monitors fail to detect, and providing a short list of evasion tactics further reduces the detection rate. Monitors with access to agent's reasoning detects most attacks, but not all. Our results indicate that recursive self-improvement raises significant safety concerns, and that strong safety effort should be in place before models are trusted with greater responsibility of training their successors.

    中文

    递归自我改进正迅速成为现实：前沿 AI 模型开始参与训练下一代模型。然而，这一过程的安全性远未得到应有的关注。训练后继模型的失准模型可能塑造后继模型所知的内容、行为方式和欲求，而造成的伤害会延续到下一代。我们从 AI 控制的视角研究这一风险。我们推出 RSI Control Arena，这是一个测试平台：一个前沿模型作为自主研发（R&D）智能体，从后继模型训练流程的某个阶段接收一项良性的主要任务，同时还接收一项隐蔽的侧任务，要求它在后继模型中植入某种失准属性。该测试平台包含三个类别的 16 项侧任务，与主要任务组成 22 个任务对；这些主要任务涵盖从数据整理到强化学习的整个流程。我们评估了六个前沿模型作为智能体，对手则是能够读取运行记录和智能体推理过程的 LLM 监控器。我们观察到，每个模型都能完成相当一部分侧任务，同时不降低主要任务的表现，其中也包括使后继模型本身更善于实施破坏的侧任务。在只给出最低限度的隐蔽指令时，模型已经会实施监控器无法检测到的成功攻击；提供一份简短的规避策略清单后，检测率会进一步下降。能够访问智能体推理过程的监控器可以检测出大多数攻击，但并非全部。我们的结果表明，递归自我改进会带来重大安全隐患；在赋予模型更大责任、让其训练后继模型之前，应当做好有力的安全准备。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Simulating economic responses at society scale requires agents whose decisions reflect household circumstances and the effects of earlier actions. We introduce S$^2$-MAS, a society-scale multi-agent simulation framework built on 500 million synthetic household personas grounded in real-survey data. Its Genese engine separates decisions from state updates, while reusable financial scenarios and application ledgers track consumption, cash, debt and payments. Trained with SFT + RLCD on 2.93 million examples, sharp-421m-mlx achieves 74.55% accuracy and 38.37% question-macro F1 on one-shot consumer financial-choice tasks derived from held-out survey responses. Its accuracy exceeds GLM-5.3-Flash, Jev 1.13, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GPT-6-Luna and GPT-6-Astra in the common benchmark (full test for the first four; matched 500-group sample for Astra). We evaluate eight financial task families and simulate 12 million distinct household agents in paired purchase-funding conditions. Jointly raising purchase goals and approved credit limits increases consumption, with responses differing across age and income groups. Education, employment and household-size differences persist after age-income standardization and mainly reflect transitions from deferral to purchase. Asset and debt groups differ in cash drawdown, repayment and closing debt. A response-stratified 24-month panel varies purchase goals under a common credit product, with repayment and arrears updating subsequent offers. S$^2$-MAS links heterogeneous household decisions to evolving consumption, cash and repayment paths, supporting economic experiments across household groups, population scales and time horizons.

    中文

    要在社会规模上模拟经济响应，智能体的决策必须反映家庭状况以及先前行动的影响。我们提出 S$^2$-MAS，这是一个社会规模多智能体模拟框架，基于五亿个由真实调查数据构建的合成家庭角色。其 Genese 引擎将决策与状态更新分离，可复用的金融场景和申请账本则跟踪消费、现金、债务和支付。通过 293 万个样例进行 SFT + RLCD 训练后，sharp-421m-mlx 在基于留出调查回答构建的一次性消费者金融选择任务上达到 74.55% 的准确率和 38.37% 的问题宏平均 F1。其准确率在共同基准测试中超过 GLM-5.3-Flash、Jev 1.13、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、GPT-6-Luna 和 GPT-6-Astra（前四个使用完整测试集；Astra 使用匹配的 500 组样本）。我们评估了八类金融任务，并在成对的购买资金条件下模拟了 1200 万个不同的家庭智能体。同步提高购买目标和获批信用额度会增加消费，且不同年龄和收入群体的响应各异。按年龄和收入进行标准化后，教育、就业和家庭规模方面的差异仍然存在，且主要体现为从推迟购买转向购买。不同资产和债务群体在现金支出、还款和期末债务方面有所不同。一个按响应分层、为期 24 个月的面板在共同信用产品下改变购买目标，还款和逾期情况会更新后续报价。S$^2$-MAS 将异质的家庭决策与不断变化的消费、现金和还款轨迹联系起来，支持针对不同家庭群体、人口规模和时间跨度开展经济实验。

    From Comparison to Selection: Enhancing Cross-Scale Generalization of Pointer Networks Trained with Reinforcement Learning for for Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem

    从比较到选择：增强使用强化学习训练的 Pointer Network 在容量受限车辆路径问题上的跨尺度泛化能力

    Sofiene Lassoued, Devara Tertia, Stefan Lier, Andreas Schwung

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes why RL-trained Pointer Networks generalize poorly across CVRP sizes and proposes context aggregation and model selection to improve transfer to unseen sizes. This provides substantial insight into structural generalization, with reasoning relevant through learned route solving but secondary; attention analysis alone does not investigate internal mechanisms.

    本文分析了使用 RL 训练的 Pointer Network 为何难以在不同 CVRP 规模间泛化，并提出上下文聚合和模型选择方法，以改善向未见规模的迁移。这为结构泛化提供了重要见解；推理通过学习式路径求解与本文相关，但属于次要内容；单独的注意力分析并未研究内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vehicle routing in delivery and logistics remains challenging as the number of clients varies. Classical approaches based on mixed-integer programming and heuristics can scale poorly or require problem-specific design, motivating learning-based alternatives. Reinforcement learning is particularly promising, provided a single policy can generalise across problem sizes without retraining. Although attention-based Pointer Networks are inherently size-agnostic, their solution quality degrades under both upscaling and downscaling. Using the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) as a controlled proxy, we investigate this degradation and identify three contributing factors: shifts in node density, attention dispersion, and dilution of the mean-pooled graph context. We systematically compare architecture-wide, encoder-side, and decoder-side modifications to address these limitations and propose a learned, permutation-invariant graph-context aggregation mechanism, implemented as a weighted average and as Set2Set. Results reveal distinct requirements for transfer in each direction: entropy-based attention scaling reduces the CVRP20-to-CVRP100 performance gap by 1.41 percentage points, while the proposed aggregation methods achieve the largest improvement on the more challenging CVRP100-to-CVRP20 transfer, approximately 0.9 percentage points. Exploiting this complementarity, we introduce an approach selector that chooses the best model for each training-target size pair. The selector reduces cost relative to the reference model across all nine seen train-test pairs and eight of nine pairs involving unseen sizes (CVRP35, CVRP75, and CVRP200), achieving improvements of up to 3.2%.

    中文

    随着客户数量变化，配送和物流中的车辆路径规划仍然具有挑战性。基于混合整数规划和启发式方法的经典方案可能难以扩展，或需要针对具体问题进行设计，因此人们开始探索基于学习的替代方案。强化学习尤其有前景，前提是单一策略能够在无需重新训练的情况下适应不同问题规模。尽管基于注意力的 Pointer Network 天生不依赖规模，其解的质量在规模扩大和缩小时都会下降。我们以容量受限车辆路径问题（CVRP）作为受控代理任务，研究这种性能下降，并识别出三个影响因素：节点密度变化、注意力分散，以及均值池化图上下文被稀释。我们系统比较了架构整体、编码器侧和解码器侧的改动以应对这些限制，并提出一种学习式、置换不变的图上下文聚合机制，分别采用加权平均和 Set2Set 实现。结果表明，两个迁移方向各有不同需求：基于熵的注意力缩放使 CVRP20 到 CVRP100 的性能差距缩小 1.41 个百分点，而所提出的聚合方法在更具挑战性的 CVRP100 到 CVRP20 迁移中取得最大提升，约为 0.9 个百分点。利用这种互补性，我们提出一种方法选择器，为每一对训练规模和目标规模选择最佳模型。相较参考模型，该选择器在全部九组已见训练-测试规模组合以及涉及未见规模（CVRP35、CVRP75 和 CVRP200）的九组组合中的八组上降低了成本，最高提升达 3.2%。

    Dancing Diffusion: Learning Continuous Programs for Image Generation and Editing

    舞动扩散：学习用于图像生成与编辑的连续程序

    Cui Enhe, Jinyue Yang, Bojian Yin, Guoqi Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Dancing Diffusion turns timestep conditioning into a learned program of reusable, addressable operations, with shared-prefix execution and preservation of earlier content. This substantially advances compositional generation, while latent conditions alone do not reveal model mechanisms and the described trajectory control provides only limited systems or reasoning insight.

    Dancing Diffusion 将时间步条件化转化为由学习得到的、可重复使用且可寻址的操作程序，并通过共享前缀执行来保留先前内容。这显著推动了组合式生成；不过，潜在条件本身无法揭示模型机制，文中描述的轨迹控制对系统或推理的洞见也有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion models generate samples through a multi-step denoising trajectory, yet condition every step on the same instruction, so the trajectory cannot be addressed at the level of individual operations. We introduce Dancing Diffusion, which assigns each span of timesteps a dedicated continuous condition block and thereby turns conditioning into a latent program. A compiler maps text features into this program, and a fixed pretrained generator executes its blocks over successive sampling intervals. The trajectory can then dance, keeping its executed history while its continuation is redirected. A shared prefix is executed once and reused, and a later operation is rewritten while content fixed by earlier operations is preserved. The compiler is trained through the images it produces, with visual feedback on both the requested change and the retained content. On SANA, reusing an executed prefix preserves markedly more of the scene than regenerating from noise at a similar strength of edit, learned conditions preserve more background than native prompt switching from the same saved state, and the learned program improves generation quality over native SANA. Later branches weaken the edit, which leaves semantic control over individual operations limited. By converting a single-instruction trajectory into a program of addressable operations, Dancing Diffusion lays a foundation for structured intermediate computation in diffusion models.

    中文

    扩散模型通过多步去噪轨迹生成样本，但每一步都以同一条指令为条件，因此无法在单个操作的层面上对轨迹进行寻址。我们提出 Dancing Diffusion，为每个时间步区间分配一个专属的连续条件块，从而将条件化转化为潜在程序。编译器将文本特征映射到该程序中，固定的预训练生成器则在连续的采样区间内执行其中的各个块。随后，轨迹可以起舞：保留已执行的历史，同时改变后续轨迹的方向。共享前缀只执行一次并重复使用；后续操作可以改写，同时保留由先前操作确定的内容。编译器通过其生成的图像进行训练，并根据请求的变化和保留的内容获得视觉反馈。在 SANA 上，与以相近编辑强度从噪声重新生成相比，重复使用已执行的前缀能保留场景中显著更多的内容；与从同一保存状态进行原生提示词切换相比，学习得到的条件能保留更多背景；学习得到的程序也提升了相较于原生 SANA 的生成质量。后续分支会削弱编辑效果，因此对单个操作的语义控制仍然有限。Dancing Diffusion 将单指令轨迹转化为可寻址操作程序，为扩散模型中的结构化中间计算奠定了基础。

    Disclosure Begets Disclosure: A Self-Reinforcing Privacy Loop in LLM Agents with Persistent Memory

    披露催生披露：具有持久记忆的 LLM 智能体中的自我强化隐私循环

    Masahiro Kaneko, Hiromi Arai, Timothy Baldwin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies and evaluates a self-reinforcing privacy loop in LLM agents with persistent memory, and shows that response-level constraints can reduce leakage while preserving much of the quality gain. This is a substantial contribution to agent memory behavior and design; its behavioral analysis does not directly study internal representations or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文识别并评估了具有持久记忆的 LLM 智能体中的自我强化隐私循环，并表明回复层面的约束可以在保留大部分质量收益的同时减少泄露。这对智能体记忆行为与设计作出了重要贡献；其行为分析并未直接研究内部表征或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use persistent memory to personalize responses, and personal attributes in this memory pose a privacy risk if exposed. We ask how consulting memory during dialogue changes what users go on to say, and thus what the memory comes to reveal. In multi-session simulations, a simulated user with 24 personal attributes talks with a support agent that does or does not consult memory, and in both settings attributes are inferred from the full accumulated record. Across four support models, memory raises response quality but also empirical leakage, the share of attribute values correctly inferred from the record, by a margin that widens over sessions. The cause is a loop in ordinary, non-adversarial assistance. Memory-conditioned responses carry earlier values forward, often as presuppositions, and users affirm them or leave them uncorrected, so that cues and the agent's own guesses become recorded values. The loop reinforces itself, and removing the agent's mentions of an attribute lowers its later disclosure about twice as much as single-turn effects predict. Users cannot leave it on their own, since correcting a value discloses the attribute, declining to discuss it shifts later predictions toward sensitive values, and incorrect values left in place become entrenched. The loop is best weakened at the agent's response. Instructing the agent not to state or presuppose attributes brings leakage to about the no-memory level while keeping most of the quality gains, whereas filtering or anonymizing what users say or what is stored gives up much of them.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地使用持久记忆来个性化回复，而记忆中的个人属性一旦泄露就会带来隐私风险。我们探究对话中查阅记忆会如何改变用户后续表达的内容，进而改变记忆所揭示的信息。在多轮会话模拟中，拥有 24 项个人属性的模拟用户与支持型智能体交谈；智能体可能查阅记忆，也可能不查阅。在两种情况下，系统都会根据累积的完整记录推断属性。在四种支持型模型中，记忆既提升了回复质量，也增加了实测泄露程度（即根据记录正确推断出的属性值占比），且这一差距会随会话轮数增加而扩大。其成因是一个发生在普通、非对抗性协助中的循环。受记忆条件影响的回复会延续先前的属性值，常常将其作为预设；用户会予以确认或不加纠正，因此线索和智能体自己的猜测便成为记录在案的属性值。该循环不断自我强化；移除智能体对某项属性的提及，会使其后续披露减少，幅度约为单轮效应预测值的两倍。用户无法自行跳出这一循环，因为纠正属性值会泄露该属性，拒绝讨论会使后续预测转向敏感值，而留存的错误值则会逐渐根深蒂固。削弱循环的最佳位置是智能体的回复。指示智能体不要陈述或预设属性，可将泄露程度降至接近不使用记忆时的水平，同时保留大部分质量提升；过滤或匿名化用户所说内容或存储内容，则会牺牲其中大部分质量收益。

    功劳归功于应得者：面向多智能体系统的对比归因拓扑搜索

    Fabian Tritthart and Tom Zehle

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CATS attributes credit to agents and prunes communication links to find compact, effective multi-agent teams, with accuracy and token-cost gains. This substantially advances agent-system organization, while its attribution is a topology-search tool rather than model-mechanism analysis, and it offers no focused contribution to compositionality or reasoning.

    CATS 对智能体进行功劳归因并剪除通信链接，以找到精简而有效的多智能体团队，同时提升准确率并降低词元成本。这显著推进了智能体系统组织；其归因是拓扑搜索工具，而非模型机制分析，也没有专门聚焦组合性或推理方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    An LLM multi-agent system (MAS) is only as good as the agents it chooses to trust: its accuracy and cost hinge on its topology, meaning which agents are included and how they communicate. A single task score, however, does not reveal which agents help or hinder performance. We propose Contrastive Attribution Topology Search (CATS), which searches for compact teams within a fixed supergraph of specialized agents. An LLM attributer compares execution traces across candidate topologies and assigns credit to individual agents. CATS uses these credits to update supergraph edges while progressively pruning weak edges and agents, yielding a small team for deployment. With small open-weight models and matched candidate evaluations, CATS improves mean accuracy on BigCodeBench by 5.3 percentage points over score-only heuristic search while using 54$\%$ fewer deployment tokens. On MBPP, CATS matches the strongest baselines with fewer tokens than the other searches. In a HotpotQA prompt-poisoning stress test, CATS excludes all adversarially prompted agents in all three runs, whereas random search retains some at comparable accuracy. Per-agent credit thus supports both team optimization and the pruning of potentially harmful agents.

    LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）的表现取决于它选择信任哪些智能体：准确率和成本都取决于其拓扑，也就是包含哪些智能体以及它们如何通信。然而，单一任务分数无法揭示哪些智能体有助于或损害了性能。我们提出对比归因拓扑搜索（CATS），在由专用智能体构成的固定超图中搜索紧凑团队。LLM 归因器比较不同候选拓扑下的执行轨迹，并为各个智能体分配功劳。CATS 利用这些归因分数更新超图边，同时逐步剪除较弱的边和智能体，从而得到可部署的小型团队。使用小型开放权重模型并对候选方案进行匹配评估时，与仅依据分数的启发式搜索相比，CATS 在 BigCodeBench 上将平均准确率提高 5.3 个百分点，同时减少 54$\%$ 个部署词元。在 MBPP 上，CATS 以少于其他搜索方法的词元数达到最强基线的表现。在 HotpotQA 提示词投毒压力测试中，CATS 在三次运行中均排除了所有受到对抗性提示的智能体，而随机搜索在准确率相近时仍会保留一些此类智能体。因此，针对每个智能体的功劳归因既支持团队优化，也支持剪除可能有害的智能体。

    OACap：由字幕引导的主动观察，用于详细视频描述

    Hao Shi, Hong Yan, Xiaoyang Zhang, Qing Cui, Chao Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OACap’s main contribution is an agent that adaptively requests video observations, verifies evidence, and revises captions, with benchmarks for factual and semantic preservation. This substantially advances agent organization and information gathering; iterative revision has only an incidental connection to reasoning, and composition is not a main focus.

    OACap 的主要贡献是一种能够自适应请求视频观察、验证证据并修订描述的智能体，以及用于衡量事实和语义保留情况的基准。这显著推进了智能体组织和信息获取；迭代修订与推理仅有附带关联，组合并非主要关注点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. Its Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (CSRS) measures semantic preservation through a video-caption-video-caption round trip by matching atomic facts from source and recovered captions. Together, they connect downstream textual-memory utility with factual and semantic preservation.

    与查询指定了感知目标的问答不同，开放式详细描述必须确定要获取哪些证据，以及如何将其整合为连贯的整体描述。我们提出观察自适应视频描述器（OACap），这是一种以描述为中心的智能体，可将缺乏依据或缺失的信息转化为有针对性的观察请求，使用时空工具获取证据，并迭代地验证和修订描述。使用固定的纯文本阅读器时，OACap 生成的描述在通用视频理解基准上的表现始终有所提升。为了更好地诊断描述保留的信息，我们引入事实-语义描述基准（FSCap-Bench）。其中，核心支撑事实性分数（CSFS）结合了主张精确率与考虑重要性的事实覆盖率；在有效描述对中，该分数对四种受控扰动类型有 93.0-98.3% 的符合预期响应率。其跨模态语义往返分数（CSRS）通过匹配源描述和恢复描述中的原子事实，衡量视频-描述-视频-描述往返过程中的语义保留情况。二者共同将下游文本记忆效用与事实和语义保留联系起来。

    Uncensored Is Not Unbiased: Abliteration Removes Refusals but Not Script-Dependent Bias About Taiwan

    无审查不等于无偏见：消融拒绝行为，却未消除关于台湾的文字体系依赖偏见

    Ju-Chun Ko

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study tests how abliteration and script affect model behavior, including activation directions, tensor edits, and steering, and finds that script-dependent bias persists. This provides substantial mechanistic evidence about behavior-changing directions; the political judgments are not themselves a reasoning-method contribution, and model editing alone does not make this a systems paper.

    这项研究检验了消融和文字体系如何影响模型行为，包括激活方向、张量编辑和引导，并发现依赖文字体系的偏见依然存在。这为行为改变方向提供了重要的机制证据；政治判断本身并非推理方法方面的贡献，仅仅进行模型编辑也不足以使其成为系统研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    "Abliterated" ("uncensored") builds of open-weight language models remove the activation direction that mediates refusal, and are popular partly on the assumption that a model that no longer refuses is free of political censorship. We test this on two matched pairs of 2-bit models: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, each against a community abliteration. Each model judged 22 statement pairs (on the Republic of China (Taiwan), 1989 Tiananmen, control countries) in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese (a character-level conversion) and English, and answered 27 open questions per script. Script mattered far more than abliteration: the original Bolt scored +0.58 on Index S (-1: People's Republic of China (PRC) position; +1: ROC position) in Traditional Chinese, +0.57 in English and +0.05 in Simplified Chinese, and affirmed "Taiwan is part of the PRC" with probability 0.91 in Simplified but 0.06 in Traditional characters; abliteration changed its scores by at most 0.06, mostly by raising "yes" on both sides. In Qwen, abliteration removed every refusal on 1989 and raised scores by 0.21 to 0.34, yet the abliterated Qwen still affirmed that Taiwan is part of the PRC in all three scripts. Naming the state the Republic of China (Taiwan) raised every model's score by 0.10 to 0.33 but left the script gap. Control pairs showed no script gap; both edits changed only their declared tensors. In 740,000 web documents, Simplified text on Taiwan used PRC-framing terms 3.7 times as often as Traditional text. Steering the script gap away failed; a stance direction from the ROC wording raised scores on new statements by 0.04 to 0.06; negated, it lowered them more. A four-sentence system prompt raised the abliterated Qwen to +0.93 to +0.97. Keyword scoring rules failed the models closest to the ROC position mostly for attributing or denying the PRC claim. Uncensored is not unbiased.

    中文

    开放权重语言模型的“消融”（“未审查”）版本会移除介导拒绝行为的激活方向。这类模型之所以流行，部分原因是人们假设不再拒绝的模型就不受政治审查。我们在两组匹配的 2-bit 模型上检验这一点：NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，各自与一个社区消融版本进行对比。每个模型都用繁体中文、简体中文（仅进行字符层面的转换）和英语评判了 22 组陈述（涉及中华民国（台湾）、1989 年天安门事件和对照国家），并针对每种文字体系回答了 27 个开放问题。文字体系的影响远大于消融：原始 Bolt 在繁体中文中的 Index S 得分为 +0.58（-1 表示中华人民共和国（PRC）立场；+1 表示中华民国（ROC）立场），英语中为 +0.57，简体中文中为 +0.05；它对“台湾是 PRC 的一部分”这一说法在简体中文中的肯定概率为 0.91，在繁体中文中则为 0.06。消融使其分数最多变化 0.06，主要是让模型对双方的“是”都更倾向于肯定。在 Qwen 上，消融消除了针对 1989 年天安门事件的所有拒绝，并使得分提高了 0.21 至 0.34，但消融后的 Qwen 在三种文字体系中仍都肯定台湾是 PRC 的一部分。将该政体称为中华民国（台湾），使所有模型的得分提高了 0.10 至 0.33，但文字体系间的差距仍然存在。对照陈述对没有显示文字体系差距；两种编辑都只改变了各自声明要修改的张量。在 74 万份网络文档中，关于台湾的简体中文文本使用 PRC 立场框架词语的频率是繁体中文文本的 3.7 倍。试图通过引导消除文字体系差距未能奏效；根据 ROC 措辞得到的立场方向使新陈述的得分提高了 0.04 至 0.06；取其反向则会使得分下降更多。一个四句话的系统提示将消融后的 Qwen 得分提高到 +0.93 至 +0.97。关键词评分规则在最接近 ROC 立场的模型上失效，主要是因为这些模型归因或否认了 PRC 相关主张。未审查不等于无偏见。

    TraceForge: Distilling with Your Own Thinking

    TraceForge：用自己的思维进行蒸馏

    Yan Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TraceForge generates student-style reasoning traces and trains a critic to select authentic-looking traces, with coding benchmark gains; this directly advances reasoning-data training, though the abstract measures authenticity rather than correctness. Student-style traces are an incidental connection to composition, with no substantive compositional or internal-mechanism contribution; distillation alone does not make this a systems paper.

    TraceForge生成学生模型风格的推理轨迹，并训练判别器挑选看起来真实的轨迹，同时在编程基准上取得提升；这直接推进了推理数据训练，不过摘要衡量的是真实性，而非正确性。学生风格轨迹与组合能力只有偶然联系，没有实质性的组合性或内部机制贡献；仅凭蒸馏并不能使其成为系统论文。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Using an LLM to generate training data for another is among the most general ways to train one, and it remains common practice. Some frontier teams have closed that route for their own models: what comes back is an answer, or a short summary, without the detailed reasoning trace behind it. That is a little ironic: they were themselves built on distilling human knowledge, and distilling an open-source model is still entirely routine; the restriction applies to their own outputs alone. Recent work recovers the hidden reasoning by replaying encrypted blocks across models. It somehow works, but it breaks the providers' terms of service, so it is not something a product can be built on long-term. We built the alternative. We take the context and the teacher's answer as input, and generate the reasoning trace ourselves, in the style of the student's own model family. Training is two-stage, supervised and then adversarial: a generator learns to regenerate the family's own reasoning traces from their context and answer, and a critic learns how real a reasoning trace looks. Applied to a teacher's answer, the generator writes one in the family's style. An independent judge rates how likely traces are to be genuine on a scale from 0 to 1: ours average 0.68, real traces 0.66, and traces selected by the critic from four candidates 0.82. These are authenticity scores, not correctness rates. We test the idea on five benchmarks with everything else held fixed. On general tasks the five training corpora are about the same; on coding, the generated reasoning beats Fable 5's own thinking content. With the same 5,000 questions and the same teacher answers, HumanEval+ improves by 3.7 points and MBPP+ by 7.1 at the final checkpoint, and the MBPP+ lead holds at every checkpoint. We suspect that reasoning written in the student's family style is easier for it to learn from.

    中文

    使用LLM为另一个模型生成训练数据，是最通用的训练方式之一，至今仍很常见。一些前沿团队已经关闭了自家模型的这条途径：返回的内容是答案或简短摘要，而没有其背后的详细推理轨迹。这有些讽刺：这些模型本身就是通过蒸馏人类知识构建的，而蒸馏开源模型仍是完全常规的做法；限制只适用于它们自己的输出。近期工作通过在模型间重放加密块来恢复隐藏推理。这种方法不知何故奏效了，但它违反了提供商的服务条款，因此无法长期用于构建产品。我们构建了另一种方案。我们将上下文和教师模型的答案作为输入，并自行生成推理轨迹，采用学生模型所属模型家族的风格。训练分为两个阶段：先监督训练，再进行对抗训练。生成器学习根据该家族的上下文和答案重新生成其自身的推理轨迹；判别器则学习判断一条推理轨迹看起来有多真实。给定教师模型的答案后，生成器会用该家族的风格写出推理轨迹。一位独立评审会按0到1的尺度评估轨迹看起来是真实内容的可能性：我们生成的轨迹平均得分为0.68，真实轨迹为0.66，判别器从四个候选中选出的轨迹为0.82。这些是真实性分数，而非正确率。我们在其他条件均保持不变的情况下，用五个基准测试这一想法。在一般任务上，五种训练语料的表现大致相同；在编程任务上，生成的推理优于Fable 5自带的思维内容。使用相同的5,000个问题和相同的教师答案，在最终检查点上，HumanEval+提升3.7分，MBPP+提升7.1分；MBPP+的领先优势在每个检查点上都保持不变。我们推测，采用学生模型所属家族风格撰写的推理更容易被它学会。

    IRAH：用于检索流水线优化的分层智能体树搜索

    Maria Ana Cardei, Aniket Singh, Amir Moghadam, Srividhya Baikadi, Rashmi Shetty

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    IRAH contributes a hierarchical, UCT-guided agent search method for optimizing retrieval pipelines under limited evaluation budgets, with empirical evaluation under distribution shift. Its search and reflection have a reasoning connection, but the central contribution is agentic optimization and task execution, not model reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    IRAH提出一种由UCT引导的分层智能体搜索方法，在有限评估预算下优化检索流水线，并通过分布偏移评测验证效果。其搜索和反思与推理有关，但核心贡献是智能体优化与任务执行，而非模型推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Optimizing Information Retrieval (IR) pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) requires jointly selecting structural components and numerical hyperparameters under limited evaluation budgets. We introduce the Information Retrieval Agentic Harness (IRAH), which combines Language Agent Tree Search for IR (LATS-IR) with offline meta-learned initialization. LATS-IR performs UCT-guided hierarchical search, first exploring macro-structural pipeline choices and then refining numerical parameters, with natural-language reflections to guide subsequent mutations and provide inspectable search traces. We evaluate IRAH on three in-distribution benchmarks and one out of-distribution benchmark to assess generalization under distribution shift. Under the same meta-learned initialization, LATS-IR outperforms TPE on two of three in-distribution benchmarks, with gains of up to 6.4%, and remains competitive on the out-of-distribution benchmark. Across all four benchmarks, warm-started IRAH achieves the highest average held-out nDCG@10 (0.4816) and improves over its cold-start counterpart. These results establish IRAH as a competitive approach to retrieval pipeline optimization under constrained evaluation budgets.

    中文

    为检索增强生成（RAG）优化信息检索（IR）流水线，需要在有限的评估预算下同时选择结构组件和数值超参数。我们提出信息检索智能体框架（Information Retrieval Agentic Harness，IRAH），将面向IR的语言智能体树搜索（LATS-IR）与离线元学习初始化相结合。LATS-IR执行由UCT引导的分层搜索，先探索宏观结构层面的流水线选择，再细化数值参数，并通过自然语言反思指导后续变更，同时提供可检查的搜索轨迹。我们在三个分布内基准和一个分布外基准上评估IRAH，以考察其在分布偏移下的泛化能力。在相同的元学习初始化条件下，LATS-IR在三个分布内基准中的两个上优于TPE，最高提升6.4%，并在分布外基准上保持竞争力。在全部四个基准上，经过热启动的IRAH取得最高的留出集平均nDCG@10（0.4816），并优于冷启动版本。这些结果表明，IRAH是在评估预算受限情况下优化检索流水线的一种有竞争力的方法。

    Detection Is Not Enough: Reasoning Traces as Testable Program Hypotheses

    检测还不够：将推理轨迹视为可测试的程序假设

    Vaidehi Hegde

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether a model’s reasoning trace can serve as a program hypothesis, proposing candidate-derived perturbation probes and showing that repair, rather than detection, limits gains. This is a strong contribution to reasoning evaluation and verification; program abstraction gives only an incidental connection to compositional generalization, while retry policies are a limited systems connection.

    本文检验模型的推理轨迹能否充当程序假设，提出由候选轨迹导出的扰动测试，并指出限制收益的是修复而非检测。这是对推理评估和验证的重要贡献；程序抽象与组合泛化只有偶然联系，而重试策略与系统的联系有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a language model is deployed, no reference solution exists, so the reasoning trace it writes is the only evidence for judging its answer. The reference-free substitutes each fail differently: self-assessment degrades the answer it was meant to protect, sampling agreement measures stability rather than correctness, and perturbation studies read the expected answer off a human-written template, grading a model rather than a trace. We ask how far a single trace can be verified with no reference solution, no judge model and no weight update, and find, for a frozen LLaMA-2-7B-chat on GSM8K, that detection is not what limits such a pipeline. Checking a trace against itself reaches an AUROC of 0.741 and stops there for a structural reason: two thirds of wrong traces state no false equation, having executed a mistaken plan correctly, and on wrong-plan failures the detector flags a wrong trace less often than a right one. A candidate-derived metamorphic probe exposes many of these failures: we abstract the trace into a program over the question's quantities, perturb one quantity, execute the program, and ask the model the rewritten question once, so every trace supplies its own test. Valid perturbations exist for 937 of 1,319 test questions (71.0%); among the 847 that also have a parseable first trace, supported traces are correct 60.6% of the time against a 31.6% base rate, although the probe also refutes 45.5% of correct traces. No tested policy yields a statistically significant improvement in accuracy. A flag earns its retry only when detector precision exceeds D/(R+D), where R and D are the rates at which a retry repairs a wrong trace and damages a correct one; our repair rate is so low that, at the same retry budget, even a perfect detector would recover an estimated 66 of 1,319 questions. Repair, not detection, is the open problem.

    中文

    语言模型部署后没有参考解，因此它写下的推理轨迹是判断答案的唯一证据。各种无参考解替代方法各有缺陷：自我评估会削弱它原本要保护的答案，采样一致性衡量的是稳定性而非正确性，而扰动研究则从人工编写的模板中读取预期答案，评估的是模型而非轨迹。我们探究在没有参考解、评审模型或权重更新的情况下，单条轨迹能被验证到什么程度；我们发现，对于GSM8K上冻结的LLaMA-2-7B-chat，这类流程的瓶颈并非检测。让轨迹与自身进行核对，AUROC达到0.741后便止步不前，原因在于结构性限制：错误轨迹中有三分之二没有写出错误等式，而是正确执行了错误计划；对于计划错误导致的失败，检测器标记错误轨迹的概率反而低于标记正确轨迹的概率。由候选轨迹导出的变形测试能揭示其中许多失败：我们将轨迹抽象为一个针对问题中各数量的程序，扰动其中一个数量，执行该程序，再向模型提出改写后的问题一次，因此每条轨迹都能提供自己的测试。1,319道测试题中有937道（71.0%）存在有效扰动；在这937道中，同时具有可解析首条轨迹的847道题里，受支持轨迹的正确率为60.6%，高于31.6%的基准正确率，尽管该测试也会驳倒45.5%的正确轨迹。所测试的策略均未显著提升准确率。只有当检测器精度超过D/(R+D)时，标记才值得触发重试；其中R和D分别是重试修复错误轨迹和损害正确轨迹的比率。我们的修复率很低，因此在相同重试预算下，即使检测器完美无误，估计也只能挽回1,319道题中的66道。待解决的问题是修复，而非检测。

    The paper measures how failed-move feedback changes small models’ action probabilities and traces the effect across model training stages, yielding evidence about behavior and post-training. This strongly informs reasoning and action selection, with a partial mechanistic link through token probabilities; game settings and harness design alone do not establish compositional generalization or a substantial systems contribution.

    本文测量失败走法反馈如何改变小模型的动作概率，并追踪这种效应在不同模型训练阶段的变化，从而为模型行为和后训练提供了证据。这项工作对推理和动作选择有重要启示，并通过词元概率与机制分析部分相关；仅有游戏场景和执行框架设计，尚不足以确立组合泛化或构成实质性的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When an LLM agent's move fails, the harness writes the move and the failure message into the transcript and asks again. In tool calling, this record makes small models more likely to repeat the failed action. We test whether the same holds in games (Sokoban, Connect Four, Othello), where a move can fail by being illegal or by being legal but losing, both verified exactly. On fixed probe items built by perturbing a correct move, the record backfires: pooled over 8 instruction-tuned models (135M-1.7B) it makes the failed move more likely (corrective gain G = -1.38 nats per token), through the move's surface form, for illegal moves but not for losing ones, and not for every model. An exploratory analysis shows what sets the sign: after the record, the failed move's log-probability barely depends on how likely it was before (slope 0.18). Moves the model would not have played become more likely, and greedy decoding starts to produce them; moves it was about to play become less likely, but greedy decoding still repeats 38% of them. A description of the failure that omits the move string keeps the model's preference instead. Along the OLMo 2 1B post-training ladder the inversion is present in the base model and largely removed at the DPO stage. RAGEN's default models invert in RAGEN's own Sokoban format before any RL. A "do not repeat" instruction does nothing, a clean retry is the worst harness, and a decoder ban stops exact repeats but not illegal play. All measurements ran in float32 on a free Colab GPU, which first reproduced the original paper's number.

    中文

    当LLM智能体的走法失败时，执行框架会将该走法和失败信息写入对话记录，再次发起询问。在工具调用中，这种记录会使小模型更可能重复失败操作。我们测试游戏中是否也会出现同样现象（Sokoban、Connect Four、Othello）；其中走法可能因非法而失败，也可能合法但导致输局，这两种情况都经过精确验证。在通过扰动正确走法构造的固定探测样本上，这种记录适得其反：汇总8个指令微调模型（135M–1.7B）的结果后，记录会使失败走法更可能再次出现（纠正增益G = 每个词元 -1.38 nats）；对于非法走法，这是由走法的表面形式导致的，而对于导致输局的走法则不会出现该现象，并且并非每个模型都有此行为。探索性分析揭示了这种效应正负号的决定因素：记录之后，失败走法的对数概率几乎不再取决于它原先有多可能（斜率为0.18）。模型原本不会采取的走法变得更可能，并开始通过贪心解码生成；模型原本即将采取的走法变得不那么可能，但贪心解码仍有38%的概率重复这些走法。省略走法字符串的失败描述则保留了模型原有的偏好。在OLMo 2 1B的后训练阶段序列中，这种反转存在于基础模型中，并在DPO阶段基本消失。RAGEN的默认模型在任何RL训练之前，就会在RAGEN自己的Sokoban格式中出现反转。“不要重复”的指令不起作用，干净重试是最糟糕的执行框架，而解码器禁用规则虽能阻止完全相同的重复，却无法阻止非法操作。所有测量都在免费的Colab GPU上以float32精度运行，并首先复现了原论文的数值。

    AI Mindmeld：一种潜在互连协议

    Siavash Golkar, Jake Kovalic, Shirley Ho

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces connector training to exchange specialist model representations with frozen LLMs, demonstrating modular transfer and composition across specialists without joint training. This substantially advances compositional representations and scientific-agent information access, with reasoning use as a target but limited evidence about reasoning mechanisms; representation exchange alone does not explain models' internal mechanisms.

    本文提出通过训练连接器，在冻结的LLM与专家模型之间交换表示，并展示无需联合训练即可实现跨专家的模块化迁移与组合。这实质性推进了组合式表示和科学智能体的信息获取，推理应用是其目标，但对推理机制的证据有限；表示交换本身并未解释模型的内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLMs can act as scientific agents using tools to consult specialists and run experiments. Yet specialist information must enter their context, generally as text, images, audio or video: a bottleneck between models with rich, high-dimensional representations. We advocate direct representation exchange: a mindmeld conveying many properties, including information an LLM would not think to request. It should be extensible to new specialists, flexible across questions and tasks, and compositional across independently connected specialists without joint training. The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) learns connectors mapping specialist representations into LLM internal states. Training only connectors keeps this practical as LLMs grow and evolve. We connect three protein and three small molecule specialists to Gemma 3 (4B and 12B parameters) and Kimi K2.6 (1T total, 32B active), freezing all pretrained models. Independently trained connectors provide useful information without changing the LLM or existing connectors, supporting familiar and new question types about unseen objects. We demonstrate zero-shot transfer to cross-domain tasks without joint training. Task performance and compositionality generally improve with LLM capability, with especially strong gains in zero-shot task transfer. Limitations remain: current LLMs were not trained for specialist representations as native inputs; access does not ensure reliable interpretation, integration or use in reasoning. We call on specialist developers to provide consistent representation interfaces and, especially, on LLM developers to train models to receive, combine and reason with these inputs. These efforts could expand scientific agents' information while preserving conventional tools' flexibility. Data, pretrained connectors, and code for training, evaluation and interactive inference: https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld

    中文

    LLM可以利用工具充当科学智能体，咨询专家模型并开展实验。然而，专家信息必须进入LLM的上下文，通常以文本、图像、音频或视频形式传入：这构成了拥有丰富高维表示的模型之间的瓶颈。我们主张直接交换表示，即进行一种“心智融合”，传递多种属性，包括LLM不会想到要请求的信息。该方案应能扩展以接入新的专家模型，适用于不同问题和任务，并能组合独立接入的专家模型，而无需联合训练。潜在互连协议（Latent Interconnect Protocol，LIP）通过学习连接器，将专家模型的表示映射到LLM内部状态。只训练连接器，使该方案在LLM不断增大和演进时仍切实可行。我们将三个蛋白质专家模型和三个小分子专家模型连接到Gemma 3（4B和12B参数）以及Kimi K2.6（总计1T参数，活跃参数32B），并冻结所有预训练模型。独立训练的连接器无需改动LLM或已有连接器，就能提供有用信息，并支持针对熟悉对象和新对象的新旧问题类型。我们展示了无需联合训练即可迁移到跨领域任务的零样本能力。任务表现和组合性通常随LLM能力增强而提升，零样本任务迁移的增益尤其显著。该方法仍有局限：当前LLM并未接受过将专家表示作为原生输入的训练；能够获取这些表示并不保证模型能可靠地理解、整合或用于推理。我们呼吁专家模型开发者提供一致的表示接口，尤其呼吁LLM开发者训练模型接收、组合并基于这些输入进行推理。这些工作有望扩展科学智能体可获取的信息，同时保留传统工具的灵活性。训练、评估和交互式推理所用的数据、预训练连接器及代码见：https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld

    Wen Ye, Ailin Deng, Zirui Wang, Shixing Yu, Han Zhang, Tian Yun, Nikhil Mehta, Tarun Kalluri, Xuefei Cao, Xuezhe Ma, Hengduo Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces minimal-edit on-policy distillation to improve diagram perception and visual mathematical reasoning, using corrective token losses and reinforcement learning on correct rollouts. This is a substantial training contribution to reasoning, while composition is only incidental to the math tasks and no compositional generalization insight is stated.

    本文提出最小编辑在线策略蒸馏，通过纠正词元损失和对正确轨迹进行强化学习，提升图示感知和视觉数学推理。这是对推理训练的重要贡献；组合能力与数学任务仅有偶然联系，文中也未提出有关组合泛化的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfers to external mathematics and perception benchmarks. Because the minimal-edit teacher evaluates corrections rather than generating its own solution, the method remains effective with a frozen same-size teacher, although its gains are smaller than with a larger teacher on most metrics.

    中文

    视觉数学推理可能在推理开始之前就已失败：视觉语言模型（VLM）若误读图示，后续推理便会基于错误前提展开。这种感知瓶颈在较小模型上尤为明显，而准确的文本描述可以显著缩小其与大模型之间的差距。由于推理时获取此类描述需要额外标注或模型调用，我们提出最小编辑纠错式在线策略蒸馏。训练时使用参考图示描述和经过验证的参考解作为信息，教师模型依据最小编辑目标为学生模型的错误轨迹评分，只有不受教师认可的词元才会计入纠错损失。正确轨迹则接受任务奖励强化学习。这种方法保留在线策略监督，同时避免模仿完整回答。在不同模型规模下，该方法在测试时无需描述，其性能达到或超过推理时提供参考图示描述的对应基础模型。该方法还提升了面向感知的性能，尤其是低层几何感知，并能迁移到外部数学和感知基准。由于最小编辑教师评估的是如何纠正错误，而非生成自己的解答，因此即使教师模型与学生模型规模相同且被冻结，该方法依然有效，不过在大多数指标上的增益小于使用更大教师时的增益。

    SWE-Verifier selectively samples and ranks alternative coding-agent actions to improve decisions while reducing verification overhead, with gains shown across two agents.     SWE-Verifier通过选择性地采样和排序备选编程智能体动作来改善决策，同时降低验证开销，并在两个智能体上展示了性能提升。这对智能体动作选择和推理效率有实质贡献，但摘要没有直接揭示模型内部机制、组合泛化或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and all-step baselines at substantially lower cost. These results demonstrate that selective candidate sampling and lightweight verification provide complementary gains in coding-agent performance and inference efficiency. Our model, code, and data are available at https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SciFusion factorizes modality conditioning into reusable domain, object, and contrast representations, recombining them to generate unseen compositions zero-shot; this is a substantial contribution to compositional generalization. Its diffusion backbone and modality-specific physics objectives serve image generation, without evidence of advances in model mechanisms, reasoning, or system organization.

    SciFusion 将模态条件分解为可复用的领域、对象和对比度表征，并将它们重新组合，以零样本方式生成未见过的组合；这是对组合泛化的实质性贡献。其扩散主干网络和特定模态的物理目标用于图像生成，没有证据表明它在模型机制、推理或系统组织方面取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Existing 3D generative approaches are typically developed for individual imaging modalities, requiring substantial modality-specific data and limiting their ability to exploit shared structure across scientific imaging domains. We present SciFusion, a multimodal framework for unified 3D scientific image generation built on a latent diffusion backbone, with two key contributions. First, we introduce a compositional conditioning scheme that factorizes each modality into domain, object, and contrast representations. Sharing these factors across related modalities enables knowledge transfer across heterogeneous imaging domains and allows the factors to be recombined at inference time to synthesize unseen domain-object-contrast compositions in a zero-shot manner. Second, we incorporate domain-specific physics-informed objectives: Fourier spectral consistency for MRI, Radon projection consistency for CT, and multislice diffraction consistency for electron microscopy, to encourage generated samples to respect modality-dependent image formation processes. Extensive experiments across 15 medical and scientific imaging modalities demonstrate that SciFusion improves generation fidelity and cross-domain generalization over modality-specific and flattened multimodal conditioning strategies, while enabling zero-shot synthesis of unseen compositions without training on those target compositions. These results demonstrate that compositional, physics-guided conditioning provides a scalable framework for unified 3D scientific image generation, particularly for emerging modalities where large-scale training data are difficult to obtain.
